entries.land_description: An organization designed for women so that they might have closer contact with the land. WWE wants to show women a way to be with nature, that is not intimidating nor fearful, yet physically challenging.
entries.notes: It is a backpacking experience. Jeanie Mudd

Joyce Cheney. I'm compiling stories of lesbian land. Format: Chapters about several lesbian lands across the US, each chapter with photos, drawings, and transcriptions of taped interviews. I'm looking for a woman or women from some part of the herstory of each women's land, who will collect stories of that land. Process is participant controlled: You'll decide whether to use false or real names and locations, and what stories to include. They're your stories! Please write!

We are a large community of women and men looking for more lesbians and wimmyn-oriented-wimmyn. By our behavior we strive to eliminate the attitudes and results of sexism, heterosexism, racism, ageism and competition. Bring no pets. NO DRUGS!
